comment: Package kit hints for the AD directory (docs/package-testing.md «Module kit file»). It requires the Active Directory integration with `demo: true`: the kit never configures a real AD — the demo directory (ad_demo_objects, seeded while AD is not set up) is what every route reads and writes. Employees and the File server are linked packages. Employees: the «AD» section of employee cards (registerEmployeeExtension) and the card links (Employees api.js: cardsForAdAccounts, findCardsByName, setAdAccount, clearAdAccount — no SQL on the employees tables). The File server: its AD connection and the people's stored AD passwords (real directory only: without the File server it answers 409 DRIVE_MISSING; the demo needs none of it) and the folder access groups (sg_…) it manages, which the directory shows and refuses to change. The demo directory links three demo employee cards to its accounts (employees.ad_account, through its own seed, guarded while the employees table is missing).
sessionsOnlyWhy: api/scopes.js BLOCKED: /app/directory is never open to API tokens (it changes Active Directory as the person's own domain account), so the token with the directory scope gets 403 ROUTE_NOT_AVAILABLE

apiParams.adCard: SELECT id FROM employees WHERE ad_account IS NOT NULL ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
apiParams.empName: SELECT substr(last_name, 1, 3) FROM employees WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

links.name: AD directory → Employees: the link picker finds employee cards (Employees api.findCardsByName)
Employees ← AD directory: the «AD» section of a card
links.absentWhy: fresh: the linked package answers without the directory; upgrade window: the linked packages are installed after it (404)

links.name: AD directory → File server: the folder access group prefix and state (works without the File server)
AD directory: groups of the demo directory, folder access groups (sg_…) marked
File server ← AD directory: the File server answers with and without the directory
links.absentWhy: fresh: the linked package answers without the directory; upgrade window: the linked packages are installed after it (404)
